core_obligations: Part (a) and the decomposition (proof lines 5247-5257): f_*O_X = O_S by the proper-flat-geometrically-reduced-connected lemma, and locally Rf_*O_X = O_S (+) P with P perfect of tor amplitude in [1, infinity), formation commuting with arbitrary base change.
Fibre computation (proof lines 5259-5268): for each s, the derived fibres of P compute H^i(X_s, O_{X_s}) for i >= 1, which vanish for i >= 2 on the one-dimensional Noetherian fibres.
Local freeness (proof lines 5268-5276): P = H^1(P)[-1] and H^1(P) is finite locally free by the lift-perfect lemma; since all steps are compatible with base change, parts (b) and (c) follow.
proof_roadmap: Establish f_*O_X = O_S with base-change compatibility.
Decompose the total pushforward locally as the unit plus a perfect complex of positive tor amplitude.
Use the one-dimensionality of the fibres to isolate degree 1.
Conclude P is the shift of a finite locally free module and transfer everything along base change.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the derived pushforwards of the structure sheaf in a nodal family with connected geometric fibres (statement lines 5235-5245). The proof (lines 5247-5276) is complete: the geometric pushforward for (a), the local perfect decomposition with tor-amplitude bookkeeping, the base-change identification of the derived fibres with fibre cohomology, the Cech vanishing in degrees at least 2 on one-dimensional fibres, and the lifting of H^1(P) to a finite locally free module. Every step is present with no omissions. H3: the perfect-complex decomposition and the lift-from-residue-field argument are genuine derived-category machinery.
